reason: Biomet Spine, LLC. announces voluntary recall of Durango Anchored ALIF Plate due to the set screw component potentially becoming dislodged from the plate assembly.
product_description:
LANX, REF, PCR8XXX-XXX, LOT, RXONLY.  Packaged within aluminum sterilization case.

Product Usage:
The Durango implant is intended for spinal fusion procedures to be used with autogenous bone graft in skeletally mature patients with degenerative disc disease (DDD) at one or two contiguous spinal levels from L2S1.

reason: Biomet Spine, LLC is recalling the Timberline Cranial Caudal and Posterior Blades, 40-180mm due to oversize of the set screw hex feature.
product_description:
Timberline Cranial Caudal and Posterior Blades, 40 - 180mm Model # 8734-2XXX, 8734-5XXX is a reusable device provided within an aluminum sterilization tray along with other instruments for use in a Timberline procedure
Timberline Anchored Lateral Retractable Drills are used with the Timberline Lateral System to establish access into the vertebrae for the screws utilized to anchor the plate to the vertebrae.
